newsitem.title: USA: Green Tree files $1 bln shelf securities.
newsitem.headline: Green Tree files $1 bln shelf securities.

text.p: Green Tree Financial Corp said Monday it had filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billlion in asset-backed securities.
When combined with a previous registration, Green Tree will have a total offering of $1.2 billion in securities, the company said.
A spokesman for the company said the securities will be used to accommodate recreation equipment and consumer loans.
Net proceeds will be used to pay its warehouse loans, and any additional proceeds will be added to Green Tree's general funds and used for general corporate purposes, the filing said.

Through its various divisions, the St. Paul, Minn.-based company purchases, pools, sells and services retail conditional sales contracts for manufactured housing and retail installment sales for home improvements, among others.
